title: Olive Finds the Gift
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 76-sound stage (ft, lt, lf just added).

pages.text: Olive had a soft gift in her nest.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl holding a small soft cloth-wrapped gift in her nest.
Olive the owl flying away from her tree hollow towards the garden.

pages.text: On the path, the gift fell.
pages.illustration: The small soft gift slipping out and landing on the garden path behind Olive.
Olive the owl walking on along the path, not noticing the empty space in her claws.

pages.text: Olive went back on the path.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl turning around and walking back along the path, looking down.

pages.text: Olive spots a soft lump in the grass.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl spotting a small soft lump among blades of grass by the path.
Close view of the small soft cloth-wrapped gift lying safe in the grass.
Olive the owl smiling, holding the gift safely again.

pages.text: Olive gets the gift back to her nest.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl flying home with the gift held carefully in her claws.
